source_review: Ordinary permanent deletion requires an enabled source, resolved containment, all ancestor junction/symlink rejection, ordinary file and cached size/mtime; isolation rechecks stable object identity and failed restore uses no-overwrite hardlink.
Workflow2 full hash checks managed paths and nanosecond file version; final kept-file hashing is followed by a fresh staged-file managed identity/version check before unlink.

Live/startup workflow2 recovery uses persisted recorded paths and object identity, same-directory validation and atomic link+unlink; collision and unsupported hardlink retain media/records instead of rename fallback.

Every CloudDrive recursive batch/single retry rechecks cancellation and current endpoint/credential binding; stop propagates through gRPC including permanent-delete fallback. Restart finalizes cancelling jobs and leaves others interrupted without automatic network work.

Schema15 binding is nullable for old plans, uses canonical endpoint plus credential SHA256 in main only, and is checked before manual resume/retry as well as RPC dispatch. Public job mapping omits the binding. settings:set blocks connection/token changes while any v3 undeleted item remains, including cancelled plans.

Existing metadata-only CloudDrive fast mode, ordinary data-table deletion, and local legacy autoDeleteAfterVerification after full hash are preserved; these are explicitly recognized policies rather than claimed full-hash guarantees for every delete.

risks.risk: CloudDrive fast candidates may have different content. RPC targets a remote path, not conditional provider ID/version; cached identity checks cannot protect an unobserved remote replacement. Owner public-release policy decision and disposable real-backend acceptance remain required.
Hidden legacy local autoDeleteAfterVerification synthesizes DELETE after successful SHA verification. Preserved compatibility behavior needs explicit public-release policy decision.
Cancelled network calls may have uncertain server-side results; no automatic restart/retry avoids new unintended calls but does not prove remote state.

Node path APIs retain a final check-to-syscall race against same-privilege concurrent malicious filesystem mutation. Hardlink-unsupported shares and interruption after link before unlink can require manual recovery with preserved media. Mapped-drive/SMB real-target validation is NOT RUN.
